<div class="page-hero">

# Teaching

This page highlights courses taught, instructional experience, online teaching, and course development from **2011 to the present**.

</div>

## Current & Featured Courses {.section-title}

<div class="current-grid">

<div class="current-card">

<span class="course-code">STT 3851</span>

### Statistical Data Analysis II

A course focused on statistical modeling, data analysis, computing, and interpretation.

<a class="course-button" href="https://lasanthiwatagoda.github.io/STT3852/">Course Website →</a>

</div>

<div class="current-card">

<span class="course-code">STT 2810</span>

### Introduction to Statistics

An introductory statistics course emphasizing statistical reasoning, data analysis, and interpretation.

<a class="course-button" href="https://www.pearsonmylabandmastering.com/northamerica/">Course Platform →</a>

</div>

</div>
